inputs.ad_text_01: A five-second black-and-white historical editorial documentary shot. Fine silver-gelatin photographic grain, neutral grayscale, soft natural light, restrained realistic human gestures, physically coherent surroundings. Locked wide shot, gentle natural motion, crisp photographic detail. No text, no subtitles, no letters, no numerals, no logos, no watermark, no split screen, no graphics, no montage, no shot changes. This is an original illustrative reconstruction, not authentic archive footage. A commercial tenant, a property manager, and a financial reviewer inspect a modest office space together. They sit at a simple table with a lease folder, a calendar and a calculator, review actual documents, then look around the usable workspace. Practical business discussion, natural gestures, balanced composition, no glamour skyscraper shot.
